name: ai4finance-foundation-finrl
tagline_zh: 打工人的外挂：ai4finance-foundation-finrl。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Build FinRL-inspired reinforcement-learning research datasets and offline strategy evaluations using QVeris-routed market data. Use for train-validate-trade experiments, state and reward design, risk controls, walk-forward evaluation, and paper-trading research without live order execution.
